source.prompt: Flagship key art for a game homepage, an ultra-wide horizontal side-scrolling arcade shooter panorama in SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired rendering with bold dark outlines, a saturated limited palette, clean vector shapes with pixel-art texture accents and a subtle CRT scanline glow, set in lifted deep-navy space that is never pure black. Left third: a small steel-blue dart fighter with a bold blue hull stripe, a glowing cyan canopy and two long orange engine ribbons flies hard to the right, nose pointing right, firing a tight fan of thin bright cyan-white player shots ahead of it. The upper-left sky above the fighter is calm and empty, just a few faint stars, left clear for a headline. Middle third: the sky is a lattice of crossing enemy fire, curving streams of pink bead bullets, fans of round red orbs and slow violet spiral chains, every bullet a bright core with a dark rim, with narrow gaps the fighter's shots thread through. Right two-fifths: the looming broadside of a colossal mechanical fish-shaped fortress-ship facing left toward the fighter, so huge its hull runs off the top, right and bottom edges of the picture; riveted gunmetal and rust-violet armor plates, a vast hinged jaw of plated teeth hanging open like a harbor gate, a dark red furnace glow building deep in its throat, rows of small turret pods and amber port lights along its seams, one great amber eye. Far background: the curved rim of a blue planet along the bottom edge with tiny dark fortress spires on it, and high up near the boss's shadow the small silhouette of a pale manta-winged second fighter climbing in for scale. Committed cyan-and-orange hero colors against the enemy's rust-violet mass, legible at thumbnail size and rich at full width. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no score.
source.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, logo, watermark, UI, health bars, title lettering, blurry, vertical composition, ship on the right, boss smaller than ship, cluttered upper left corner, dark unreadable silhouette
